newsitem.title: UK: Venezuela's Matos sees no change to public pay.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Matos sees no change to public pay.

text.p: Venezuela's finance minister on Wednesday said he expected no change to the country's budgetted public sector wage rises.
"We expect no modification of the 1.3 billion bolivars (for public sector wage rises) in the budget," Luis Raul Matos Azocar told a conference.
"The medical sector we increased, but we are very firm in our negotiations with rest of the public sector."
Matos also said the government would continue to aim for 25 percent inflation this year, compared to about 100 percent last year.
"We have to work very strongly towards that, and we have set up economic policies for that target," he said.
Some analysts have said the target may be too modest given the pressure on the government to increases wages in the public sector.
